pages.quiz:
SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Composition of Air? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Composition of Air.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Composition of Air.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Composition of Air.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Composition of Air.

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Light? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Light.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Light.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Light.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Light.

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Change of State? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Change of State.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Change of State.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Change of State.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Change of State.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Invertebrates? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Invertebrates.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Invertebrates.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Invertebrates.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Invertebrates.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Invertebrates and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Change of State and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Composition of Air and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. A — Ice melting to water

7. D — Glucose and oxygen

9. C — Producers

10. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Invertebrates.
